ads.body: Map the plan, roles, exercises and contact register into one reviewable readiness dossier. See supported, stale and human-dependent states separately.
ads.hook: Your incident plan can be complete on paper and still incomplete in evidence.

slides: Can every claim point to evidence?

video_storyboard.visual: Scattered plan, role matrix and contact sheets
video_storyboard.voice: Readiness evidence rarely ages at the same speed.
DIO separates coverage, currency, authority and action.
A dossier informs the decision. It never makes the incident decision for you.

visual_direction.concept: Operational evidence under pressure, shown as a calm command map rather than disaster imagery.
